title: should hide the value input for a unary is_null operator and save without error
verifies: selecting is_null removes the value input and the condition saves with no inline error and the drawer closes

title: should round-trip a saved unary operator on edit and restore the value input for a binary operator
verifies: a saved is_null operator reloads with the value input hidden and switching to '=' restores the value input

title: should offer all four unary operators in the condition operator dropdown
verifies: is_null, is_not_null, is_empty, and is_not_empty are all offered in the operator menu

title: should still require a value for a binary operator after unary operators are added
verifies: a binary '=' operator with an empty value still surfaces the inline validation error

title: should clear a previously entered value when switching to a unary operator
verifies: switching from '=' with a stale value to is_null clears the value so switching back leaves the field empty
